info.name: EduNest API — Auth + Provision + Teacher + Schedule + Student Portal
info.description:
# RUN ORDER â€” follow top to bottom on a fresh import

0. Start the backend (`npm run dev` in `backend/`). Set `superEmail`/`superPassword` collection variables from `backend/.env`.
1. `00 Health` â†’ must be ok:true.
2. `01 Auth`: run `01` (saves instituteId), then `04 Login - Super Admin`.
3. `02 Super`: `List Pending` â†’ `Approve Request` (or `Reject Request` for the second school).
4. `01 Auth`: run `05b Login - Admin` â€” this switches your cookies to the school admin (needed for everything below).
5. `04 Provision`: run `Teachers/Create Teacher` â†’ `Classes/Create Class` FIRST â†’ then `Students/Create Student` (needs classId) â†’ `Settings/Set Terminal Class`.
6. `01 Auth`: run `10 Login - Teacher` (switches cookies to teacher), then use `05 Teacher` + `06` teacher requests.
7. `01 Auth`: run `11 Login - Student` for `06` student requests (`My Attendance`, student timetable).
8. `06`: admin creates timetable â†’ teacher checks `Today Schedule` â†’ teacher `Mark Attendance` â†’ student `My Attendance`.

Cookies: Postman stores the httpOnly session automatically. Re-run the matching login request whenever you switch roles. Test scripts auto-save all IDs/temps into collection variables.

---

# EduNest API â€” Manual Testing Collection

Covers **all currently implemented routes** (`backend/src/app.ts`):

- `GET /api/health`
- `POST /api/auth/admin-request`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/refresh`, `/api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me`
- `GET /api/super/requests`, `POST /api/super/requests/:id/approve`, `POST /api/super/requests/:id/reject`
- `POST /api/super/institutes`, `GET /api/super/institutes`, `GET /api/super/institutes/:id`, `PATCH /api/super/institutes/:id/status`
9. `07 Student Portal`: login as student (01 Auth / 11), then `My Profile/Dashboard/Attendance/Timetable/Teachers/Results/Fees`.
10. `08 Complaints`: student POST + /mine (3rd today → 429) → teacher inbox (own only) → admin inbox + moderate.
11. `09 Fees`: admin create → student My Fees → teacher submitted → admin paid → audit trail.
12. `10 Tests & Results`: teacher create test → save marks (over-max → 400) → publish result → student My Results.
13. `11 Notices`: admin/teacher create → role-scoped list (student POST → 403) → update/delete.

New routes in this update:
- `GET /api/students/me|/me/dashboard|/me/timetable|/me/teachers|/me/results|/me/fees`
- `POST+GET /api/complaints (+/mine|/teacher|/admin)`, `PATCH /api/complaints/:id`, aliases `GET /api/teacher/complaints`, `GET /api/admin/complaints`
- `POST+GET+PATCH /api/fees`, `PATCH /api/teacher/fees/:id/status`, `GET /api/fees/:id/audit`, aliases under `/api/admin/fees`
- `POST+GET /api/tests`, `POST|PATCH /api/tests/:id/marks`, `POST+GET /api/results`
- `POST+GET+PATCH+DELETE /api/notices`

item.name: 06 Schedule & Attendance
item.description:
PREREQUISITES â€” run these first (top to bottom), otherwise IDs are empty and every request fails:
1. `01 Auth â†’ 05b Login - Admin` (admin cookies).
2. `04 Provision â†’ Teachers â†’ Create Teacher` (saves teacherId, teacherLoginId, teacherTempPassword, teacherPhone).
3. `04 Provision â†’ Classes â†’ Create Class`, then `Assign Teacher` with the teacher above (saves classId).
4. `04 Provision â†’ Students â†’ Create Student` in that class (saves studentId, studentLoginId, studentTempPassword).
5. `01 Auth â†’ 10 Login - Teacher` before teacher requests; `11 Login - Student` before student requests.
Then run this folder top to bottom: Timetable â†’ Today Schedule â†’ Class Info â†’ Attendance.

Timetable + today-schedule + class-info + attendance. Flow: admin creates timetable â†’ teacher checks today-schedule â†’ teacher marks attendance â†’ student views own attendance.

item.name: 07 Student Portal
item.description: Student self-service — login via `01 Auth / 11 Login - Student` first. Every request derives identity from the cookie (`protect → allowRoles(student) → scopeInstitute → checkStatus`). studentId is never trusted from the client.

request.description: Read-only own profile + current class + class history. `GET /api/students/me`. Reset-password = contact admin.
Composed dashboard: profile + month attendance % + fee due + latest-3 notices + timetable overrides + results %. `GET /api/students/me/dashboard`. Powers portal /student/home with ONE call.
Own month % + days. `GET /api/students/me/attendance?month=YYYY-MM`. Pre-request sets month to current. Only recorded days count — unrecorded days are never absent.
Own-class week grid + extra/cancelled overrides. `GET /api/students/me/timetable?week=YYYY-MM-DD` (Monday-start week derived server-side).
Own-class teachers only: ID/Name/Subject/Class. No phone/email/contact. `GET /api/students/me/teachers`. Feeds complaint dropdowns.
Own exams + aggregates for bar/pie. `GET /api/students/me/results?exam={{examName}}`. Teacher/class joined per subject where known.
Alias of above via student router. `GET /api/students/me/results?exam={{examName}}`.
Own due/paid/history. `GET /api/students/me/fees`. overdue = dueDate < today. Read-only — no amount/status edit here.
Negative test: replace :id with another class of the same institute → 403. Uses {{classId}} — swap manually to a foreign class to verify.

item.name: 08 Complaints
item.description: Privacy-critical. Student: POST + GET /mine only (2/day → 429, immutable). Teacher: own inbox only (never admin rows). Admin: full + mirror. Login as matching role before each subfolder.
